entries.subject: Radius and orbit adopted from the published record
entries.finding: Radius 1.63 (+0.23/-0.20) Earth radii from Jenkins et al. 2015 (AJ 150, 56 (2015); arXiv:1507.06723), at 6378.137 km per Earth radius. No mass is measured, so no gravitational parameter is adopted. A sphere: no oblateness is measured. Orbit: Jenkins et al. 2015 (AJ 150, 56 (2015); arXiv:1507.06723), Table 3: 384.843 d Inclination 89.806 degrees from Jenkins et al. 2015, Table 3. The scaled distance a/R* = 202.63 is DERIVED here from their semimajor axis 1.046 AU and stellar radius 1.11 solar radii, not quoted. Jenkins et al. 2015, Table 3, leave the eccentricity unconstrained (e cos omega = 0.03 +0.75/-0.39, e sin omega = -0.02 +/- 0.31; no radial-velocity detection), so the orbit is drawn circular. Jenkins et al. 2015, Table 3: epoch BJD 2454833 + 314.985.
